name: Cenarion Moondust
summary: At the Moonkin Stone east of Auberdine, Cenarion Moondust summons Lunaclaw. Night elf druids use it in their final trial to become Druids of the Claw.

sections.title: A Rite of the Claw
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker gives Cenarion Moondust to young druids in Darnassus for their final trial of heart and body. To face Lunaclaw, an initiate travels to the moonkin dens east of Auberdine in Darkshore. Scatter the powder on the ancient Moonkin Stone, and Lunaclaw comes to test the druid in combat. Through the trial, the initiate gains the enduring strength needed to channel bear form.

faq.q: What is Cenarion Moondust used for?
faq.answer: Night elf druid initiates scatter Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone in Darkshore. It summons Lunaclaw and tests their strength and resolve as they seek bear form.

faq.q: Where do I use the Cenarion Moondust?
faq.answer: Scatter Cenarion Moondust over the Moonkin Stone in a moonkin cave in the hills directly east of Auberdine in Darkshore.
Mathrengyl Bearwalker, a druid trainer at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, gives Cenarion Moondust to initiates ready for the trial of body and heart.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the moondust?
faq.answer: If you lose the moondust or spend it in a failed attempt against Lunaclaw, return to Darnassus and ask Mathrengyl Bearwalker to renew the trial.

angles.text: As a night elf druid, using Cenarion Moondust begins the final step toward becoming a Druid of the Claw and mastering bear form.
As a night elf, you meet the ancient traditions of the Cenarion Circle in the dust. It joins nature worship with lunar ritual to honor Darkshore's beasts.
